_source: Ozzbit Games 'male hero' free walk, 10 frames, 128px cells. Read by hand from 14x gridded zooms.
_frames_start_at: reference frame 5 = near foot heel strike (front contact)
units: reference pixels; hip x = 63, shoulder = (63, 61), ground y = 80, figure height ~37
notes: Stance = 6 of 10 frames (feet planted from contact until toe-off); swing = 4 frames.
Planted foot slides back about 3 px per frame, evenly: a steady, purposeful push.
Swing foot lifts high (4 px, ~40% of leg length) right at passing, then reaches forward and drops.
Fists swing much further FORWARD than back, and rise to chest height in front (elbow bent ~90 deg).
Fist trailing behind stays low by the hip with the arm nearly straight.
Body is lowest at contact, rises through passing and stays high until the next contact.
Frame-4 '0.5' was the heel peeling up while the toe stays planted; it is handled by sole tilt, not by lifting the whole foot.
